The 2018 Toyota Highlander XLE brings genuine three-row versatility together with the kind of long-term reliability Toyota built its reputation on, making it an easy choice for families who need real room without sacrificing peace of mind. This Highlander comes to us no-accident and one-owner, a clean, single-household history that speaks for itself, plus a nonsmoker cabin that still feels fresh. From behind the wheel, this Highlander still feels every bit as solid and composed as it did the day it was first driven home. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL Shoppers gravitate toward the Highlander because it strikes a rare balance: genuine three-row seating and real cargo versatility in a package that never feels like a chore to drive or park. Toyota's reputation for long-term reliability runs deep here, and the Highlander has become a go-to choice for families who plan to keep a vehicle for the long haul rather than trading it in every few years. A smooth, composed ride and confident highway manners round out the appeal, making longer road trips with a full load of passengers feel far less tiring than in many competing three-row SUVs. Strong resale value is another major part of the story, a direct reflection of just how much buyers trust the Highlander's durability over time. It's the kind of vehicle owners recommend to their friends and family without a second thought. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION This generation of Highlander earned a 2018 IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK award, a recognition that required meeting that year's newly tightened headlight-performance standard, reflecting a genuinely well-rounded approach to occupant protection. WARRANTY This Highlander shows 63,795 miles on the odometer, and its original Toyota factory coverage has run its course over the years since it was first registered in December 2017. At a well-maintained 63,795 miles, this Highlander sits comfortably in objectively low mileage territory for a vehicle of its age, a strong sign of a well-cared-for one-owner history rather than a vehicle nearing the end of its usable life. STANDARD FEATURES XLE trim brings a genuinely well-rounded set of comfort and convenience upgrades to the Highlander lineup, striking a sweet spot between the mainstream trims below it and the flagship models above. Standard three-row seating makes this Highlander a true family hauler rather than a compact crossover pretending to be one, while XLE-specific comfort and convenience touches make everyday errands and long road trips alike feel noticeably less like work. INSTALLED OPTIONS Roof Rack Cross Bars Ready to accept a cargo box, kayak mount, or bike carrier right away, adding real hauling versatility for road trips and outdoor gear without needing an aftermarket install. MECHANICAL FEATURES A 3.5-liter V6 engine makes 295 horsepower and 263 lb-ft of torque, giving this Highlander confident, effortless acceleration whether merging onto the highway or passing on a two-lane road. NO PLUGGING IN NECESSARY -- this Highlander runs on gasoline alone, with straightforward fill-ups and no charging equipment to plan around, ever. An 8-speed automatic transmission keeps that power smooth and well organized, while Toyota's all-wheel drive system quietly shifts torque to the wheels with the most grip, adding genuine confidence in rain, snow, or loose gravel. Rated to tow up to 5,000 pounds, this Highlander is ready for a small trailer, boat, or a loaded utility hauler without a second thought. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in Predawn Gray Mica, this Highlander wears a sophisticated, understated shade of gray that looks equally at home in a school pickup line or a weekend getaway. Roof rack cross bars add genuine practicality to the exterior, keeping bulky cargo off the interior floor and out of the way of passengers. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, standard three-row seating gives this Highlander real flexibility for growing families, carpools, and weekend trips alike, with a versatile second row that keeps third-row access simple rather than a genuine chore. XLE-level comfort touches make the cabin feel noticeably more upscale than the trims below it, without asking passengers to give up everyday practicality. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY A touchscreen display keeps navigation, media, and vehicle settings within easy reach from the driver's seat, with smartphone connectivity and Bluetooth keeping everyone in the cabin connected on longer drives. SAFETY FEATURES A comprehensive airbag system and a full suite of stability and traction control technology work quietly in the background to help keep every passenger, across all three rows, protected in the event of the unexpected. This Highlander's IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK recognition reflects genuinely strong occupant protection across the board, giving families real confidence on every trip. ... and there's SO MUCH more! This Highlander has spent years getting the whole family where they're going, and it's ready to keep doing exactly that. Both physical and digital bids enter the exact same live inventory pool in real time. The 60-Day Rolling Auction Window: All advertised auction inventory is subject to an active, rolling sixty (60) day digital and physical auction cycle. No vehicle will be sold, contracted, or released at the advertised opening bid price prior to the official 60-day auction closing date, unless a buyer executes an active, higher competitive bid or selects the separate, explicit "Buy It Now" retail checkout option. Conditional Right of First Refusal at Auction Close: If a vehicle fails to receive higher competitive bids or a "Buy It Now" execution during its 60-day cycle, and the highest active bid at the end of the 60 days matches the original opening bid price, the Company may contact that highest bidder to finalize the transaction at that price. "Buy It Now" Price Transparency: If a vehicle is listed on our platform with an active "Buy It Now" option, the price displayed is the full, transparent, upfront retail offering price for that vehicle. In strict compliance with federal truth-in-advertising guidelines and FTC Section 5 guidelines, this "Buy It Now" price is the actual amount any consumer can pay to buy the vehicle, excluding only mandatory government charges. Dealership Right of Cancellation & Force Majeure: The Company reserves an absolute, unconditional right to cancel any opening bid, auction transaction, or "Buy It Now" availability at any point during or at the conclusion of the 60-day cycle if an unprecedented or intervening event occurs. This includes, but is not limited to: vehicle theft, lot accidents, newly discovered mechanical defects, frame or structural anomalies, or severe weather damage that alters the vehicle's roadworthiness, safety profile, or physical condition. Strict $0.00 Fee Policy: Power Motor Group, Inc DBA 109 Certified proudly charges $0.00 in Documentation Fees, $0.00 in electronic filing fees, and $0.00 in dealer preparation or dealer certification fees. There are absolutely no hidden fees, pre-checked add-ons, or mandatory forced accessory packages added to any invoice. Final contract figures exclude only mandatory government charges (local sales tax, DMV title registration fees, and license plate transfer costs) calculated strictly based on the Buyer's verified residential or corporate registration address at final checkout. For additional transactional information, please contact an authorized dealership manager in person at our Lindenhurst, NY facility. Online displayed prices represent a Starting Minimum Auction Opening Bid Only. Only vehicles bearing a clear, distinct visual tag or explicit text designation marking them as "Immediate Baseline Eligible" may be contracted and purchased on the spot at the baseline opening bid price prior to the completion of a 60-day auction cycle. Standard Inventory Requirements: Any active inventory vehicle lacking an explicit promotional designation cannot be purchased immediately at the opening bid price. Experience the thrill of driving the 2018 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Ti, a stylish SUV that combines Italian craftsmanship with modern technology. Finished in the striking Vulcano Black Metallic paint, this used vehicle offers a sleek, commanding presence on the road. With just under 76,000 miles, it delivers an exhilarating 280 horsepower from its turbocharged 2.0L four-cylinder engine, perfectly paired with an automatic transmission and all-wheel drive for confident handling in all conditions. Inside, the black leather seats with memory and heated options provide comfort and luxury, while features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and satellite radio make every drive connected and entertaining. The hands-free liftgate, keyless entry, push start, fog lights, xenon headlights, and a 4-door layout ensure convenience and style, making this Stelvio Ti a compelling choice for those seeking performance and sophistication.

This Alfa Romeo Stelvio is equipped with a host of advanced features to enhance your driving experience. It includes a backup camera for added safety, and the touch-screen infotainment system with an 8.8-inch display and eight speakers ensures crisp audio and easy control. Electronic messaging assistance with read and voice-activated functions keeps you connected safely on the go. On the safety front, Brembo premium brakes, dual front knee airbags, front and rear parking sensors, ABS, anti-lock door locks with auto-locking, hill descent assist for off-road confidence, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off provide peace of mind and security. Whether navigating city streets or exploring off the beaten path, this Stelvio Ti offers a well-rounded package of safety and security features.

2018 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Safety and Security Features

This SUV boasts premium Brembo brakes that deliver excellent stopping power, complemented by dual front knee airbags for added occupant protection. Parking sensors at both the front and rear help with maneuvering in tight spots, while the 4-wheel ABS ensures stability during sudden stops. Power door locks with anti-lockout and auto-locking functions enhance security, and hill descent assist provides control on steep declines. The electronic parking brake with auto-off adds convenience, making this Stelvio Ti a dependable and secure vehicle for daily driving and adventure alike.

2018 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Entertainment and Technology Features

Stay connected and entertained with a comprehensive suite of tech features. The voice-operated hands-free phone call system and HD radio deliver crisp audio and seamless communication. The 8.8-inch infotainment touchscreen, combined with eight speakers, offers easy access to media and navigation. Electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions ensures you stay in touch safely, while the USB auxiliary input expands your listening options. Designed to keep you engaged and connected, this Stelvio Ti combines Italian elegance with modern technology.

2018 Alfa Romeo Stelvio Performance Features

The Stelvio Ti includes auto start/stop technology to improve fuel efficiency during city driving, while its on-demand all-wheel-drive system provides optimal traction and stability across diverse terrains. These performance features, combined with spirited handling and responsive power delivery, create an SUV that’s as enjoyable to drive on city streets as it is on open highways. Whether commuting or exploring, this vehicle offers a dynamic and confident ride.

This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.

This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
